name: ChainMind Blockchain MCP Server
description: Multi-chain blockchain operations with AI-friendly programmable APIs

tools.name: multi_balance
tools.description: Fetch aggregated balances across multiple blockchain addresses (Ethereum and Solana). Returns balances for all provided addresses in a single response.

addresses.description: Comma-separated list of blockchain addresses (ETH and/or SOL)

eth.description: Object with Ethereum addresses as keys and balances in ETH as values

sol.description: Object with Solana addresses as keys and balances in SOL as values

tools.name: auto_send
tools.description: Send conditional/automated transactions on Ethereum or Solana. Only executes the transaction if specified conditions are met (e.g., minimum balance threshold).

senderPrivateKey.description: Private key of the sender (hex for ETH, JSON array for SOL)

amount.description: Amount to send (in ETH or SOL)

condition.description: Optional condition to check before sending

message.description: Message if condition was not met

tools.name: token_summary
tools.description: Get comprehensive token summary for multiple addresses across Ethereum and Solana, including native balances, ERC-20/SPL tokens, and NFT counts.

addresses.description: Comma-separated list of blockchain addresses (ETH and/or SOL)

eth.description: Object with Ethereum addresses as keys

properties.tokens: Object with token symbols and balances

sol.description: Object with Solana addresses as keys

properties.tokens: Object with token mints/symbols and balances

features: Automated transaction triggering based on balance thresholds
Optional Supabase integration for transaction logging
security_notes: Private keys are handled server-side only
Use environment variables for RPC endpoints
Consider rate limiting for production use
